name: @tokamak-zk-evm/backend-wasm
description: Web-compatible Tokamak zk-EVM prover and verifier package scaffold.
author: Tokamak Network

scripts.build: npm run subcircuit-library:generate && npm run verifier-crs:generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json --pretty false
scripts.typecheck: npm run subcircuit-library:check && npm run verifier-crs:check && tsc -p tsconfig.json --pretty false --noEmit
scripts.typecheck:scripts: tsc --pretty false --noEmit --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --lib ES2022,DOM --types node scripts/check/artifacts/check-binary-artifacts.ts scripts/check/prover/check-field-buffer-ops.ts scripts/check/fixtures/check-fixtures.ts scripts/check/fixtures/check-native-verifier-fixture.ts scripts/check/polynomial/check-polynomial-buffer.ts scripts/check/polynomial/check-polynomial-fixtures.ts scripts/check/prover/check-prover-commitment-ops.ts scripts/check/prover/check-prover-fixture.ts scripts/check/prover/check-prover-stage-timing.ts scripts/check/prover/check-prover-testing-mode.ts scripts/check/prover/check-prover-polynomial-ops.ts scripts/check/prover/check-prover-witness.ts scripts/check/fixtures/check-runtime-fixtures.ts scripts/check/browser/check-verifier-browser.ts scripts/check/verifier/check-verifier-fixture.ts scripts/fixtures/convert-artifacts.ts scripts/fixtures/copy-fixtures.ts scripts/diagnose/diagnose-verifier-fixture.ts scripts/generate/generate-format-specs.ts scripts/generate/generate-subcircuit-library.ts scripts/generate/generate-verifier-crs.ts scripts/fixtures/prepare-runtime-fixtures.ts test/benchmarks/msm/bench-prover-msm-layout.ts test/browser/verifier-entry.ts
scripts.prover:ops:check: npm run prover:ops:field && npm run polynomial:buffer:check && npm run prover:ops:polynomial && npm run prover:ops:commitment
